title: XCP: Adding support for ASAM XCP
description:
- Supporting first commands of XCP 1.5
- Supporting XCP over CAN but not all commands
- Supporting XCP over Ethernet but not all commands

Not supported yet:
- SW DEBUG OVER XCP (except names)
- POD Interface (except name)
- STIM DTO frames (including registering PIDs for it)
- ERRORS
- Interleaved communication

Closes: #20280

can you check the clang analyzer ouptut ?

there is a lot of warning about derefence stuff
https://gitlab.com/LarsVoelker/wireshark/-/jobs/8582027149
I am not sure what to do there. Every pointer dereference is called out, even when it cannot be NULL. What am I missing here?
This looks like false positives. I added some (unnecessary) checks to make it more obvious to clang.

I prefer to set flags for 32-bit fields to e.g., 0x00000001 rather than 0x01, though I realise it makes little difference:

Warning: epan/dissectors/packet-xcp.c hf_xcp_program_clear_range_fct_1 filter= xcp.packet.clear_range_fct.clear_all_calibration_data mask 0x01 with len 2 but type FT_BOOLEAN | 32  indicates should be 8

Warning: epan/dissectors/packet-xcp.c hf_xcp_program_clear_range_fct_2 filter= xcp.packet.clear_range_fct.clear_all_code_areas mask 0x02 with len 2 but type FT_BOOLEAN | 32  indicates should be 8

Warning: epan/dissectors/packet-xcp.c hf_xcp_program_clear_range_fct_4 filter= xcp.packet.clear_range_fct.clear_all_nvram_areas mask 0x04 with len 2 but type FT_BOOLEAN | 32  indicates should be 8

changed this line in [version 8 of the diff](/wireshark/wireshark/-/merge_requests/18373/diffs?diff_id=1205574915&start_sha=d2b0483686e244d95ce7fecdb0f383e2d85bb057#56999dcafe57e30cfff9a791f9ecf0a806f94980_4114_4119)
Changed

These 2 functions could/should be static (from check_static.py, not in the pipeline):

epan/dissectors/packet-xcp.c  (0000000000000020 T check_config) is not referred to so could be static? 

epan/dissectors/packet-xcp.c  (0000000000005b00 T xcp_lookup_memory_address) is not referred to so could be static?
Made static.
Also, running './tools/convert-glib-types.py epan/dissectors/packet-xcp.c' found some instances of the glib types that may be replaced.
Fixed.
What happens if the type is not XCP_TYPE_ETHERNET?  Can we continue, or should we return out with 0?
Of the currently implemented types only Ethernet has this additional header. CAN does not have that. I made this more obvious in the code.
Made this more obvious.
